newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast details November coffee bean exports.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast details November coffee bean exports.

text.p: Ivory Coast exported 3,550 tonnes of robusta coffee beans in November 1996, against 8,030 tonnes in October and 7,914 tonnes in November 1995, official shipping data show.
Shipments included 1,932 tonnes of beans leaving from Abidjan and 1,618 tonnes from San Pedro, the second port.
No roasted coffee was shipped but 765 tonnes of soluble coffee also left from Abidjan, against 820 tonnes in October and 660 tonnes in November 1995.
Cumulative coffee bean exports in the first two months of the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) season were 11,580 tonnes against 13,922 tonnes in the same period of 1995/96.
Coffee exports were slowed in early 1996/97 by a combination of unfavourable world demand, low prices and bankers' caution over export financing.
